name: np_helicopter
character: A police helicopter: a thump at the blade-passing frequency with a dozen harmonics, a faster and higher tail rotor and a rough turbine hiss; it comes in high and far, crosses overhead and stays above the flyover.
note: Main rotor blade-pass 26.7 Hz (4 blades at 400 rpm, general knowledge); tail rotor tones higher and faster (the research note). ESTIMATE: blade count, rotor speed, tail-rotor frequency and levels are starting values
